y-m-09-03.title: Ngaba ngokwenene ngama-2 km ukusuka ekhaya ukuya kwithala leencwadi?
y-m-09-03.topic: Iiyunithi zobude (km, m) nobude obulinganiswe ecaleni kwendlela
y-m-09-03.goal: Qonda ukuba nangokubala kwamanani okufanayo, xa kulungile nalapho kungalunganga kwahluka ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni uthetha ubude bendlela ephi, uze wahlule oko unokukumisela nokungenakukumisela xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha.
y-m-09-03.material: UHajun uthe, "Ukusuka ekhaya ukuya esikolweni yi-1 km 200 m, kwaye ukusuka esikolweni ukuya kwithala leencwadi yi-800 m. Ngoko ukusuka ekhaya ukuya kwithala leencwadi yi-2 km!" Awukayiboni imaphu. Bonke ubude "bububude obulinganiswe ngokuhamba ecaleni kwendlela." (1 km yi-1000 m. km ifundwa kilomitha kwaye m ifundwa mitha.)

y-m-09-03.s.s1.o.b: Imeko apho uthetha ubude xa ithala leencwadi likwindlela enye phakathi kwekhaya nesikolo
y-m-09-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba ithala leencwadi lisondele ekhaya kunesikolo, umgama ukusuka ekhaya ukuya kwithala leencwadi kufuneka ube mfutshane kunowasekhaya ukuya esikolweni. Lixabiso elitshintsha ngendawo.
y-m-09-03.s.s1.o.c: Imeko apho uthetha ubude bendlela esuka ekhaya idlula esikolweni iye kwithala leencwadi
y-m-09-03.s.s1.r.c: Oku kucinga kuhlole ukuba uthetha indlela enye eyenziwe ziinxalenye ezimbini ezidityanisiweyo.
y-m-09-03.s.s1.o.d: Imeko apho uthetha ubude bendlela esondele kakhulu ukusuka ekhaya ukuya kwithala leencwadi
y-m-09-03.s.s1.r.d: Akumiselwanga ukuba indlela esondele kakhulu yeyo edlula esikolweni. Asazi ngezinye iindlela okwangoku.
y-m-09-03.s.s1.explain: Indlela ehamba isuka ekhaya idlula esikolweni iye kwithala leencwadi yindlela edibanisa iinxalenye ezimbini, ngoko yi-1 km 200 m kudityaniswe ne-800 m, eyi-2000 m, okanye 2 km. Ukuba uthetha ezinye iindlela okanye ezinye iindawo, awukwazi ukuthi eli xabiso lichanekile.

y-m-09-03.s.s2.r.d: Nokuba kukho into ongayaziyo, cinga ukuba ikhona na into onokuyithi ngendlela osele uyaziyo.

y-m-09-04.title: Ukuqikelela Ubunzima Beapile Enye Ngesikali Sebhalansi
y-m-09-04.topic: Ubunzima (g) nokufumana uluhlu ngokuthelekisa kwisikali sebhalansi
y-m-09-04.goal: Nokuba awukwazi ukwazi ixabiso elichanekileyo, thi uluhlu lobunzima ukusuka kwiziphumo zokuthelekisa, nciphisa uluhlu ngezinto ezintsha ezibonwayo, uze ucinge ngomda wokuba izixhobo onazo ngoku zinokunciphisa ngakumbi na.
y-m-09-04.material:
Ubeka iapile kwipani enye yesikali sebhalansi kunye neewiyiti kwenye ipani ukuthelekisa. Icala elinzima liyehla, kwaye ukuba iiwiti ziyalingana, lilinganayo. Zikho iiwiti ezininzi nganye ye-50 g, 100 g, 200 g, kunye ne-500 g. Masithi zikho iiapile ezininzi ezinobunzima obufanayo ngqo, kwaye ubunzima beapile e-1 linani lemvelo nge-g.
Okubonwayo 1: iapile e-1 ngokuchasene neewiti ezimbini ze-200 g → icala leapile lehle.
Okubonwayo 2: iapile e-1 ngokuchasene neewiti enye ye-500 g → icala lewiti lehle.
